intent_summary: The default recipe builds an expectation from earlier matching seasonal observations and a training-fitted level, linear, or compound-growth model.

criteria.criterion: A supplied season length selects earlier matching seasonal observations for the reference.
criteria.notes: Independent lag values and robust matching-phase assertions establish the seasonal reference calculation.

criteria.criterion: Automatic trend selection represents suitable linear and compound growth without flagging ordinary growth as point anomalies.
criteria.notes: Positive and negative linear/exponential cases select the expected model, match post-training expectations, and produce no ordinary-growth episodes.

criteria.criterion: The fitted trend remains frozen after training within a regime; later changed values do not rewrite that fit.
criteria.notes: Trend fitting occurs at the training boundary; the test asserts identical trend diagnostics and earlier evidence after later observations change.

criteria.criterion: Callers can explicitly select none, linear, or exponential trend, and unsupported trend modes are rejected.
criteria.notes: Tests exercise disabled, linear, exponential, and invalid quadratic modes, including disclosed short-history fallback.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent re-inspected declared implementation references and criterion evidence in the current session after the outcome-title and deliverable-lane refactor.
